source_observation.baseline: ComponentConfig files can share common parameters among component instances through one ConfigMap. Instance-specific values such as a host IP or hostname cannot be shared this way and have remained command-line parameters; existing deployments therefore combine a shared config file with instance-specific flags.
source_observation.requested: Add a separate versioned {Component}InstanceConfiguration Kind and --instance-config file interface for instance-specific parameters, while preserving shared configuration, legacy flag precedence, and the isolation of instance values from Dynamic Kubelet Config replacement.

source_observation.baseline: Existing AppArmor support uses beta annotations on Pods and PodSecurityPolicies to choose profiles and define allowed/default profiles. Profiles must be available on the node and the runtime applies them. Pod annotation updates are accepted but only affect a container after restart, with no API indication of the effective value.
source_observation.requested: Promote the existing feature to GA, replace annotations with functionally equivalent dedicated fields, and deprecate the annotations. Bridge both representations in the API server for creation, updates, validation, policy enforcement, and version skew. New kubelets use immutable Pod fields and ignore annotation updates.
